mapper.select: select attr.alarm_flow_id,u.link_id from vm_flow_link_user u LEFT JOIN vm_flow_link_attr attr on attr.id = u.attr_id where u.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY attr.alarm_flow_id,u.link_id

select fll.template_id as alarm_flow_id,flic.link_id from vm_flow_link_industry_config flic INNER JOIN vm_flow_template_link as fll on flic.link_id = fll.cur_link INNER JOIN vm_flow_template as ft on ft.template_id = fll.template_id and flic.app_ver_code = ft.app_ver_code and flic.industry_code = ft.industry_code where flic.delete_flag = 0 and flic.app_ver_code =#{appVerCode} and flic.industry_code =#{industryCode} and FIND_IN_SET(#{roleId},flic.role_id) GROUP BY fll.template_id,flic.link_id UNION all select fll.template_id as alarm_flow_id,flic.link_id from vm_flow_link_industry_config flic INNER JOIN vm_flow_template_link as fll on flic.link_id = fll.cur_link INNER JOIN vm_flow_template as ft on ft.template_id = fll.template_id and ft.app_ver_code is null and ft.industry_code is null where flic.delete_flag = 0 and flic.app_ver_code is null and flic.industry_code is null and FIND_IN_SET(#{roleId},flic.role_id) GROUP BY fll.template_id,flic.link_id union all select attr.alarm_flow_id,r.link_id from vm_flow_link_role r LEFT JOIN vm_flow_link_attr attr on attr.id = r.attr_id where r.role_id = #{roleId} and attr.app_ver_code =#{appVerCode} and attr.industry_code =#{industryCode} GROUP BY attr.alarm_flow_id,r.link_id

select.if:
select attrSub.attr_id as attrId,attrSub.link_id as linkId,userOrRoles from vm_flow_link_attr attr
left join (select attr_id,group_concat(user_id SEPARATOR',') as userOrRoles from vm_flow_link_user where attr_id=#{attrId} and link_id=#{linkId}) as attrSub on attrSub.attr_id = attr.id
left join (select attr_id,link_id,group_concat(role_id SEPARATOR',') as userOrRoles from vm_flow_link_role where attr_id=#{attrId} and link_id=#{linkId}) as attrSub on attrSub.attr_id = attr.id
